A resourceful young dark-skinned human woman with short natural black curls, an emerald explorer's coat with original geometric brass embroidery, leather map harness and a luminous brass navigational compass stands on an ancient moss-covered lookout bridge in the foreground. Her face and upper body are prominent in the upper-middle third, confident and thoughtful, not resembling any known character or real person. In the background and around her, a wondrous vertical city of floating basalt terraces forms three clearly separated elevation levels: a few distant golden waypoints connected by long bridges in the upper sky, more waypoints and shorter connections in a middle layer, many closely connected glowing cyan nodes and small bridges in the lower city.
